title: The Aviary and Bill Moore's MUFON speech

tellings.quote: the aviary was this long rumored uh like it was like bird code names assigned to kind of disinfo agents around UFO related truth. So people like Rick Dodie, John Leer, uh it's kind of associated with Bill Moore and the agents where he made that muon speech

plain: In the 1980s, Michels says, a rumored group called the Aviary gave bird code names to agents who spread false information about UFOs, and he names Rick Doty and John Lear as among the people linked to it. He ties it to a UFO researcher named Bill Moore and the agents Moore described in a speech to MUFON, a large civilian UFO research group. Michels tells this himself as a "long rumored" story, without naming a source, while describing how government agencies may have muddied the UFO subject.
